audit: Visual screenshot and design-comparison evidence coverage
runtimeScope: Existing screenshot/browser evidence is inventoried for all families. Light/LTR and Dark/RTL evidence is linked for all 18; narrow/zoom proxy coverage is limited to a subset. A narrow same-size primary-Button host-crop pixel diagnostic exists for Light/LTR and Dark/RTL; no complete family/state-by-state pixel-diff or full side-by-side design comparison was performed. The zoom-200 scenario is a reflow proxy, not native browser UI zoom. Native OS high-contrast and assistive-technology acceptance are not represented. Dated Icon, Slider and RangeSlider review-board addenda update design traceability only; they add no matched browser/Fluent parity evidence.
